description: This Java source file defines the DisruptorCommandExecutor class, which implements a command execution framework using the LMAX Disruptor library for high-performance event processing. It manages command event lifecycle, integrates middlewares and routing, and provides mechanisms for executing and closing resources.

classes.name: DisruptorCommandExecutor
classes.description: Main class implementing command execution using Disruptor, supporting command dispatch, resource cleanup, and event publication.

classes.name: DisruptorCommandExecutor.CommandEvent
classes.description: Generic class representing a command event with its associated command and future result.

classes.name: DisruptorCommandExecutor.CompleteableCommandEventHandler
classes.description: Event handler class that processes command events, applies middlewares, routes commands, and manages completion or exceptions.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a command by placing it onto the disruptor ring buffer and returns a Supplier for the result.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Shuts down the disruptor to release resources.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Publishes a command event to the disruptor ring buffer and returns the event object.
